Interpretation and portable source

  • The selected metal cohort contains routine Water samples from SWS-2023 with an Unfiltered result fraction. A reported range uses quantified values for the same metal, method, unit and fraction.
  • Below-limit observations retain their original blank value and unit fields, detection condition, limit type, limit value and limit unit. Open markers locate the limit; they are not substituted concentrations.
  • Sampling support is17 distinct activities. SV-245 has one sampled activity; the other four stations have four each. Different stations have different monthly schedules.
  • Same-activity chemistry uses original result basis. No hardness conversion or concentration unit conversion is applied.
  • Save selection creates a source-bound JSON file. Reopen selection verifies both the original source edition and selected record IDs. The scientific source ZIP contains the selected report, native figure specifications/SVGs, selected CSVs, the complete original source files and this reusable explorer.
  • In the installed Upper Savannah application, import the ZIP’s sources.json with the ordinary source importer. Choose its OBSERVED_CONTEXT source in Scientific Reports; ordinary editable transfer retains its complete companion tree.
